title: Paediatrics: reflection and OSCE prompts
description: Prompts for portfolio reflection and practice stations.

questions.q: What did I learn today that changed how I approach an unwell infant?
questions.answer: Model: describe the learning, why it mattered, what I will do differently, and one action with a date.

questions.q: OSCE: Explain to a parent why their baby needs phototherapy.
questions.answer: Model: introduce, check understanding, explain bilirubin simply, how light helps, safety (eyes, feeding), what to expect, check questions, safety-net.

questions.q: How would I communicate with a worried parent while a clinician is busy?
questions.answer: Model: acknowledge, be honest about my role, offer to find the right person, do not give clinical advice beyond my role.
